title: 08 — Before & After (UGC Native)
description: Native UGC before/after transformation. Side-by-side (or top/bottom) selfie frames shot in the same bathroom — left/top is grainy, dim, "before" state; right/bottom is bright, natural, "after" state. Handwritten-style date labels. Looks stitched together in CapCut, not professionally designed. The format wins by NOT looking like an ad.
